name: Мешок с шипами
alt: Из потрёпанного мешка высыпались железные шипы, а ботинок опасливо обходит их.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, legible at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple shapes, strong readable silhouette. Large centered subject with comfortable margins and minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, card frame, border or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated parts. Subject: One battered open dark green cloth drawstring pouch tipped over, spilling exactly five chunky iron caltrops onto a small dungeon flagstone. Each caltrop is a simple four-pointed metal jack with one point upward. A single empty oversized brown adventurer boot nearby is tipped onto its toe as if anxiously avoiding the spikes, no foot or person inside. Comical dangerous floor clutter, readable simple composition.
